Who We Are
Euronext Securities Copenhagen is part of the network of Euronext CSDs, channeling investments into local economies and supporting European capital markets.
Euronext Securities offers a safe and efficient market infrastructure to support the business requirements of investors as well as competitive and tailored solutions to help issuers meet their funding needs and reach a wide base of local and international investors.
Euronext Securities covers all stages of the value chain, from pre-settlement, settlement, custody to a complete range of asset services.

Er du privat investor?
Har du spørgsmål til dine værdipapirer i depot hos VP Securities, skal du altid kontakte dit pengeinstitut.
VP Securities kan desværre ikke hjælpe ved specifikke forespørgsler. Vi beklager ulejligheden.
Are you a private investor?
If you have any questions about your securities in custody at VP Securities, you should always
contact your bank.
Unfortunately, VP Securities cannot not help with specific inquiries. We apologise for any
inconvenience.
